EC1: Patients posing a serious suicidal risk [OR] and/or violence as judged by the investigator;
EC5: Patients with a history of hypothyroidism [AND] [NOT] unless taking a stable dose of thyroid medication and asymptomatic or euthyroid for 6 months;
EC6: Patients who meet DSM-IV-TR  criteria [AND] for any significant current substance abuse;
EC7: hepatic insufficiency  (three times the upper limit of normal (ULN) for aspartate aminotransferase (AST) [OR] and/or alanine aminotransferase (ALT)) [OR]; liver transplant [OR] recipient; cirrhosis of the liver;
EC8: malignancy ([NOT] except basal cell carcinoma) [OR] and/or chemotherapy  within 1 year prior to screening [OR]; malignancy more than 1 year prior to screening must have been local and [NOT] without metastasis [OR] and/or recurrence, and if treated with chemotherapy, without nervous system complications;
EC9: significant unstable medical condition [OR] or life threatening disease with anticipated survival of less than 6 months;
EC10: need for therapies that may obscure the results of treatment and/or of the study
EC11: Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days of the screening visit;
EC12: Anticipated inability to attend scheduled study visits;
EC13: Patients who in the judgment of the Investigator may be unreliable or uncooperative with the evaluation procedure outlined in this protocol;
EC14: Patients with a history of prior pharmacogenomic testing;
EC15: Any change in psychotropic medication (including change in dosage) between screening and baseline;
EC16: Patients who are known to be pregnant or lactating;
EC17: Patients with a history of gastric bypass surgery.
